title: HubSpot vs ActiveCampaign (2027): CRM-First Suite or Automation-First Email Tool, Prices, Free Plan, Startup Discounts and Which One Fits Your Startup

facts.fact: HubSpot's free plan covers up to 2 users with no credit card required and includes 2,000 email sends a month with HubSpot branding.
facts.quote: Free plan for up to 2 users, no credit card; 2,000 email sends a month with HubSpot branding

facts.fact: HubSpot Starter is listed at $7 per seat a month on annual billing as a limited-time offer for new customers, with $20 shown as the regular price.
facts.quote: Starter $7 per seat a month (limited-time new-customer offer; $20 shown as the regular price)

facts.fact: HubSpot Professional starts at $800 a month on annual billing and includes 3 seats.
facts.quote: Professional from $800 a month (3 seats)

facts.fact: HubSpot Professional carries a one-time onboarding fee of $3,000.
facts.quote: Professional $3,000, Enterprise $7,000 one-time onboarding

facts.fact: HubSpot Enterprise starts at $3,600 a month on annual billing and includes 5 seats, with a $7,000 one-time onboarding fee.
facts.quote: Enterprise from $3,600 a month (5 seats)

facts.fact: HubSpot extra core seats on Professional cost $45 a month each, according to HubSpot's pricing page.
facts.quote: 3 core seats (extra seats from $45 a month)

facts.fact: HubSpot's AEO tool costs $50 a month ($45 on annual billing) and has a 28-day trial, according to HubSpot's page.
facts.quote: HubSpot AEO tracks how your brand shows up in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for $50 a month ($45 on annual billing), with a 28-day trial

facts.fact: HubSpot's free CRM allows storing non-marketing contacts for free, up to 15 million.
facts.quote: You can store non-marketing contacts in the CRM for free, up to 15 million.

facts.fact: HubSpot's free plan includes one automated action in email automation, while Starter includes up to 10 automated actions.
facts.quote: 1 automated action (Free), up to 10 (Starter), unlimited and omni-channel (Professional)

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign has no free plan and offers a 14-day free trial without a credit card, plus a 30-day money-back guarantee, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: No free plan; 14-day free trial, no credit card; 30-day money-back guarantee

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign list prices on annual billing for 1,000 contacts are $15 (Starter), $49 (Plus), $79 (Pro) and $145 (Enterprise) a month.
facts.quote: Starter $15, Plus $49, Pro $79, Enterprise $145 a month for 1,000 contacts

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's Incubator programme offers 90% off any annual plan in year one, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign Incubator: 90% off any annual plan in year one

facts.fact: HubSpot for Startups offers up to 90% off Professional or Enterprise in year one, 50% in year two and 25% in year three.
facts.quote: gives 90% off year one, 50% in year two and 25% in year three to startups that raised pre-seed, seed or Series A money

facts.fact: HubSpot's second startup tier gives 30% off in year one through approved entrepreneurial organisations.
facts.quote: A second tier gives 30% off year one through approved entrepreneurial organisations.

facts.fact: HubSpot for Startups eligibility covers startups that raised pre-seed, seed or Series A money, not Series B or later.
facts.quote: to startups that raised pre-seed, seed or Series A money (not Series B or later)

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's Active Intelligence AI is included in every plan with 500 AI credits a month.
facts.quote: Its AI, Active Intelligence, is included in every plan with 500 AI credits a month

facts.fact: HubSpot Starter includes 1,000 marketing contacts, 500 HubSpot Credits and sends of 5 times the contact tier per month.
facts.quote: It includes 1,000 marketing contacts, a send limit of 5 times your contact tier a month

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's Starter plan allows 5 actions per automation, and unlimited actions start from the Plus plan.
facts.quote: 5 actions per automation (Starter), unlimited from Plus; 950+ automation recipes

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign states it offers over 950 automation recipes.
facts.quote: a visual automation builder with 950+ recipes

facts.fact: HubSpot's vendor page states it offers over 2,000 apps in its integrations.
facts.quote: Integrations | Over 2,000 apps

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's vendor page lists 1,000+ integrations, including Zapier, Claude and ChatGPT via MCP.
facts.quote: 1,000+ integrations, Zapier, Claude and ChatGPT via MCP

facts.fact: The authors checked both vendors' pricing pages in their default view, with USD and annual billing selected, in October 2026.
facts.quote: Both pages showed USD with annual billing selected by default

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign includes unlimited automation actions starting from its Plus plan, according to the page.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign gives more automation for less money: unlimited automation actions from Plus, 950+ recipes, predictive sending and conditional content from Pro.

facts.fact: HubSpot's Free plan is limited to one automated action, and its Starter plan to 10 automated actions, per the page.
facts.quote: HubSpot limits Free to one automated action and Starter to 10; unlimited, omni-channel automation starts on Marketing Hub Professional.

facts.fact: HubSpot Free allows 2,000 email sends per month.
facts.quote: HubSpot Free allows 2,000 sends a month

facts.fact: HubSpot paid plans allow email sends of 5x (Starter), 10x (Professional) or 20x (Enterprise) the marketing contact tier.
facts.quote: paid plans allow 5 times (Starter), 10 times (Professional) or 20 times (Enterprise) your marketing contact tier.

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign allows email sends of 10x the contact limit on Starter and Plus, 12x on Pro and 15x on Enterprise.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign allows 10 times your contact limit on Starter and Plus, 12 times on Pro and 15 times on Enterprise.

facts.fact: HubSpot for Startups offers up to 90% off Professional or Enterprise in year one for startups with pre-seed to Series A funding and an approved partner or verified venture funding.
facts.quote: HubSpot for Startups gives up to 90% off Professional or Enterprise in year one for startups with pre-seed to Series A funding

facts.fact: The ActiveCampaign Incubator offers 90% off any annual plan in year one for startups under 2 years old, linked to an incubator, with no more than $1 million raised.
facts.unit: % off any annual plan in year one
facts.quote: The ActiveCampaign Incubator gives 90% off any annual plan in year one to startups under 2 years old, linked to an incubator and with no more than $1 million raised.

facts.fact: HubSpot's Breeze AI features run on HubSpot Credits, with 500 credits on Starter and 3,000 on Professional.
facts.quote: HubSpot's Breeze agents and AI features run on HubSpot Credits (500 on Starter, 3,000 on Professional).

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign includes 500 AI credits on every plan through Active Intelligence.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign includes Active Intelligence with 500 AI credits on every plan
